title: Sumerian accounts of civilizations from before the moon

tellings.quote: civilizations pre-moon that talk about they talk about you know the moon not existing and then there you know Sumerians talk about the premoon civilizations

plain: The Sumerians, an ancient people of Mesopotamia, are said to have spoken of civilizations that existed before there was a moon in the sky. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, on an episode with a guest named Randall Carlson titled around the idea that the moon is an alien spaceship. If true, it would mean the moon arrived within human memory.
